plantedBugs.description: No exhaustiveness check — if a new StageAction type is added, handleAction silently returns null instead of failing at compile time. Should use switch with never or assertNever.
Return type is inferred as Promise<unknown> | null — callers have no type safety on the result. Should explicitly type the return.
Each branch calls a different async function but results are not awaited — fire-and-forget pattern may hide errors.
